bar: MET if on every host run: the base (unmutated) trial reproduces the pinned 16-token CIS2_REF; sha256 and the witness move for 100% of data mutations; the witness BODY digest moves for 100% of 1-ULP single-element edits and 100% of INT8 tensor round-trips, and for >=95% of sign/exponent single-bit flips (mantissa flips reported as measured, no bar); the header-only control moves sha256 and the witness (the §12.1 witness header folds weights_sha256) and does NOT move the body digest nor the argmax digest; argmax-level (greedy-token) detection is reported as measured per class, no bar. Seeds 20261016 (w3), 20261017 (w4), 20261018 (hq) = the same mutants as w1x-tamper v1. Mutant files are never published. Registered after w1x-tamper v1 results were seen (its control clause was mis-specified; v1 is scored against its frozen bar as registered).
title: w1x-tamper2: real-weight tamper detection v2 on the pinned SmolLM2-135M safetensors, three detection levels (witness incl. §12.1 header; witness BODY = per-step full fp32 logits + argmax ids, header excluded; greedy-token argmax digest), base trial, header-only control

summary: All three host runs (w3 seed 20261016, w4 20261017, hq 20261018; template v2) MET every clause: base trial = pinned CIS2_REF on each; sha256 and witness moved 55/55 (54 mutants + control) on each; witness BODY digest moved 54/54 on each (1-ULP 24/24, INT8 6/6, random bit flips 24/24; sign/exponent flips 11/11, 13/13, 12/12 = 100%); header-only control moved sha256 + witness and did NOT move body or argmax on all three (meta_control PASS). Argmax (greedy-token) detection as measured: w3 4/54, w4 5/54, hq 3/54 (1-ULP 0/72; INT8 9/18; bit flips 3/72 incl. sign/exp 2/36).
